meta.description: Curated practice positions for each theme and aggression level

positions.description: IQP position - White has isolated d-pawn, Black blockades
positions.task: Find White's best plan. Should White play for e4 break or maneuver?

aggressionMap.0-20: Solidify, avoid trades, prepare e4 carefully
aggressionMap.61-80: Sacrifice on e4 or d5 for attack

positions.solution: e4! with idea of e5, Ne5, piece activity. Solid: prepare with Re1, Bf3 first.

positions.task: White to play. How to handle hanging pawns?

aggressionMap.21-40: Classical: develop, wait for Black's commitment
aggressionMap.41-60: Active: c5 or d5 break when ready

positions.solution: Development first. Break timing critical. c5 vs d5 depends on Black's setup.

positions.description: Fixed center (French-like) - White space, Black ...c5/...f6 breaks
positions.task: White to play. Space advantage - how to use it?

aggressionMap.0-20: Squeeze: Nf3, Be2, 0-0, Qd2, prevent breaks
aggressionMap.41-60: Active: prepare f4/f5 or queenside play

positions.solution: Prevent ...c5 and ...f6. Maneuver knights to e5/f4. Space = time.

positions.description: Bad bishop vs good knight - White's light bishop blocked
positions.task: White to play. Improve worst piece (Bc1).

aggressionMap.41-60: Active: sacrifice pawn to free bishop

positions.solution: Bd2! preparing Bf1-g2 or trade on f6. Don't leave bad bishop.

positions.description: Outpost on d5 - White knight vs Black bishop
positions.task: White to play. Establish knight on d5.

aggressionMap.41-60: Active: immediate Nd4, sacrifice pawn for outpost

positions.solution: Nf3-d4! with c3 support. Knight on d5 dominates.

positions.task: White to play. Does Bxh7+ work? Calculate.

aggressionMap.21-40: Calculate deeply. Only if forced win.

positions.solution: Bxh7+! Kxh7 Ng5+ Kg6 Qg4+ Kh7 Qf4+ Kg7 Qg4+ perpetual or win. Calculate!

positions.description: h-file attack - Rook lift to h3
positions.task: White to play. Launch h-file attack.

aggressionMap.61-80: Rh3! sacrifice on h7 if needed

positions.solution: Rh3! threatening Nh4, Qh6. Classic h-file attack.

positions.task: White to play. Win with opposition.

positions.solution: Kd4! (distant opposition). Then Ke4, Kf5, etc.

positions.description: Reti maneuver - king catches passed pawn
positions.task: White to play. Draw by catching pawn.
positions.solution: Kg7! Diagonal approach. h7 Kf6 Kf7 draw.

positions.task: Choose aggression level and find move

decisions.aggressive: c5! dxc5 d5! - sacrifice for attack

usage.weekly: Full set for theme of week
usage.method: Set up on board, set timer (5-10 min), find move/plan, verify with engine, annotate
usage.tracking: Log: position ID, time, move found, engine eval, lessons learned
